turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: (laughs) Well, I think there may be a slight misunderstanding here. There's no record of a parrot named Polly being involved in Pavlov's research. Ivan Pavlov actually used salivating dogs to study classical conditioning. He rang a bell every time he presented the dogs with food, and eventually, the dogs started salivating when they heard the bell, even without the food. This showed how associations can be formed between stimuli.
